purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Assam/Dhubri land-record custody and a current ILRMS/Dharitree viewer are evidenced. The viewer returned district/circle selection metadata but no anonymous parcel ID plus geometry response; runtime remains held and no sample GeoJSON is retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Assamese first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-11857-dhubri.json. Results identified the official Dhubri district portal, Assam Directorate of Land Records, ILRMS/Dharitree, and DILRMP status information, but no verified open parcel geometry endpoint.
requestOutcomes: The current ILRMS viewer loaded HTTP 200; its JavaScript exposed record-selection POST routes. Dhubri district circle lookup returned HTTP 200 with eight circles, while the Dhubri village lookup returned HTTP 500. The alternate language viewer loaded HTTP 200 with CAPTCHA/record workflow. DILRMP direct curl failed TLS verification and no exception was used. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA bypass or unsafe field request was made.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [26.0444154617722, 89.9643320981953] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No city boundary or complete Dhubri coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry, native parcel identity, schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
DILRMP programme status and general cadastral-mapping prose are not treated as proof of an open local registry adapter.
A CAPTCHA workflow, HTTP 500, timeout or TLS verification failure is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. A future retained sample must use exactly one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties and document its source field here.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The local/state land-record custodian and Dhubri location hierarchy are evidenced, but anonymous viewer/API access to parcel geometry, city scope, schema, CRS and stable native parcel IDs remain unknown.
